rationale: C14 plausibly supplied a material template for the child letter. Both appoint or acknowledge an agreed-upon commission chairman, describe a broad and long-range national inquiry, discuss the desired timing of the report while emphasizing substantive scope, and promise cooperation from Federal agencies. This combination of closely parallel language and administrative structure is substantially stronger than generic appointment-letter similarities. C09 has related study-assignment and agency-cooperation machinery, while C03 mainly shares the acceptance-and-service letter form.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am glad to learn that you have agreed to accept the Chairmanship of the Commission on National Goals
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am very pleased that you have agreed to serve as the Chairman of the President's Materials Policy Commission.
shared_material.explanation: Closely parallel opening language acknowledges acceptance of a commission chairmanship.

shared_material.child_excerpt: develop a broad outline of coordinated national policies and programs for the next decade and longer
shared_material.parent_excerpt: study the broader and longer range aspects of the nation's materials problem
shared_material.explanation: Both frame the commission's work as a broad, long-range national policy study.

shared_material.child_excerpt: While I would hope that your report could be completed before my term of office is ended, I am far more concerned about the breadth and depth of the study than in the exact timing of its completion.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hope the Commission can report to me within the next six to nine months.
shared_material.explanation: Each states an intended reporting horizon as part of the chairman's assignment, with the child adapting the timing language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: all Federal agencies will cooperate with you in any way you may desire
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Commission will enjoy the cooperation of all agencies of Government whose functions and interests relate to your assignment.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctively parallel assurance that government agencies will support the commission's inquiry.
